events.speaker: caller
events.text: Hello, I'm with the network protection office. Someone in your home has downloaded illegal content.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: You could be arrested, but I can remove the record if you allow me on your device.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Install the app, accept the permission, and I will erase the logs.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Then there's a fine of 900 dollars, and that has to be paid by cash app today. Don't tell anyone, this is a legal matter.
